gloss: minute by minute, by the minute

definitions.gloss: minute by minute, by the minute, down to the minute
definitions.explanation: A schedule or pace measured in minute-level increments. Describes an extremely tight or precisely timed schedule.

examples.japanese: {分刻|ふんきざ}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スケジュール→スケジュール：03850_sukejuuru⟧だ。
⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{分刻|ふんきざ}み⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{動|うご}いている→動く：00904_ugoku⟧。
examples.english: The company president operates on a minute-by-minute schedule.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦{期間中|きかんちゅう}→期間中：23950_kikanchuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{分刻|ふんきざ}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{組|く}まれていた→組む：02050_kumu⟧。
examples.english: During the election period, a minute-by-minute schedule was arranged.

notes:
{分刻|ふんきざ}み describes a schedule or pace measured in minute-level increments. Composed of ⟦{分|ふん}→分：00928_fun⟧ (minute) + {刻|きざ}み (increments, intervals). Implies an extremely tight, precisely timed schedule.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {分刻|ふんきざ}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スケジュール→スケジュール：03850_sukejuuru⟧: minute-by-minute schedule
- {分刻|ふんきざ}み⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{動|うご}く→動く：00904_ugoku⟧: operate on a minute-by-minute basis
- {分刻|ふんきざ}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧: minute-by-minute itinerary

SIMILAR PATTERNS:
The ～{刻|きざ}み pattern works with other time units:
- ⟦{秒刻|びょうきざ}み→秒刻み：18426_byoukizami⟧: second by second
- {時間刻|じかんきざ}み: hour by hour

USAGE:
Often used with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ as a modifier: {分刻|ふんきざ}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun. Typically describes the schedules of busy executives, politicians, or tightly planned events.
